title: Clinical Simulation & Patient Room
text: Examine a patient, place electrodes, acquire a 12-lead ECG, and answer for your clinical reasoning across scored cases.

title: Interactive Cardiovascular Anatomy
text: A real-time 3D model of the heart and great vessels with 24 selectable structures. Orbit, zoom, isolate a region, and read referenced anatomy.

title: Cardiovascular Disease Explorer
text: Disease modules across twelve categories, each following the same structure: overview, risk factors, step-by-step pathophysiology, investigations, and management.

title: ECG & Bedside Monitoring
text: A realistic hospital cardiac monitor running continuously animating rhythms. Play, pause, scrub, step frame by frame, and read a synchronised explanation.

title: Clinical Examination
text: An interactive three-dimensional thorax, male and female, that you rotate and inspect. Place electrodes and stethoscope to hear synchronised heart sounds.

title: Cardiovascular Key Points
text: Concise, referenced revision topics covering the material students are examined on and use on the ward.

title: Cardiovascular Glossary
text: Definitions, formulae, and typical values for the vocabulary of cardiology, each cross-linked to the anatomy and disease modules.
